meta.rule: A paragraph may be attached only if it sits on the card's own source page and literally addresses the claim (agreement or contradiction). No cross-source paragraph is attached, and no threshold is changed.
meta.context: The data-supply matcher resolved 75/100 cards. This review re-read the same pages and recovered ten cards whose wording did not clear the 0.50 threshold, then added two explicit page-status flags. A second pass re-read the remaining unresolved pages and recovered four more; the other twelve were left unresolved because the archived page is a hub, a table the extractor does not turn into paragraphs, or a Chinese edition. No threshold was lowered.
